in.title: [International Logistics #6] Menyewa Kapal: Voyage, Time, dan Bareboat Charter (serta Mengapa Setiap Hari Tambahan Berbiaya)

segments.src: > Most cargo ships that carry grain, ore, or oil are rented, not owned. The contract used to rent one is a "charter party," and the type you pick decides who pays for what and who carries the risk of delays.
segments.tr: > Sebagian besar kapal kargo yang mengangkut gandum, bijih, atau minyak disewa, bukan dimiliki. Kontrak untuk menyewa kapal disebut "charter party", dan jenis yang dipilih menentukan siapa membayar apa dan siapa yang menanggung risiko keterlambatan.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Container lines run fixed schedules, and you buy space on their ships much like buying a seat on a bus.
segments.tr: Perusahaan pelayaran kontainer menjalankan jadwal tetap, dan Anda membeli ruang di kapal mereka seperti membeli kursi bus.

segments.src: But if you need to move 60,000 tons of soybeans or a full load of crude oil, you rent a whole ship.
segments.tr: Namun jika Anda perlu memindahkan 60.000 ton kedelai atau muatan penuh minyak mentah, Anda menyewa seluruh kapal.

segments.src: That rental is called **chartering**, and the contract is called a **charter party**.
segments.tr: Penyewaan itu disebut **chartering**, dan kontraknya disebut **charter party**.

segments.src: The ship's owner is the **shipowner**.
segments.tr: Pemilik kapal disebut **shipowner**.

segments.src: The person renting it is the **charterer**.
segments.tr: Pihak yang menyewa disebut **charterer**.

segments.src: There are three main types.
segments.tr: Ada tiga jenis utama.

segments.src: The easiest way to remember them is how much of the ship you take over:
segments.tr: Cara termudah untuk mengingatnya adalah dari seberapa banyak kapal yang Anda ambil alih:

segments.src: Voyage charter: renting a trip (like a taxi)**
segments.tr: Voyage charter: menyewa satu perjalanan (seperti taksi)**

segments.src: You hire the ship to carry a specific cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: Anda menyewa kapal untuk mengangkut muatan tertentu dari pelabuhan A ke pelabuhan B.

segments.src: The shipowner runs the ship and pays its operating and voyage costs: crew, fuel (called *bunkers*), and usually port charges.
segments.tr: Pemilik kapal mengoperasikan kapal dan membayar biaya operasional serta biaya perjalanan: awak, bahan bakar (disebut *bunkers*), dan biasanya biaya pelabuhan.

segments.src: You pay **freight**, usually a price per ton of cargo (for example, $45 per ton).
segments.tr: Anda membayar **freight**, biasanya harga per ton muatan (misalnya $45 per ton).

segments.src: Your main job is to get the cargo loaded and unloaded on time.
segments.tr: Tugas utama Anda adalah memastikan muatan dimuat dan dibongkar tepat waktu.

segments.src: Time charter: renting the ship for a period (like a car with a driver)**
segments.tr: Time charter: menyewa kapal untuk jangka waktu tertentu (seperti mobil dengan sopir)**

segments.src: You rent the ship for a set time, such as six months or one round trip, and pay **hire** at a daily rate (for example, $15,000 per day).
segments.tr: Anda menyewa kapal untuk jangka waktu tetap, misalnya enam bulan atau satu kali pulang-pergi, dan membayar **hire** dengan tarif harian (misalnya $15.000 per hari).

segments.src: The owner still provides the crew and handles maintenance and insurance.
segments.tr: Pemilik tetap menyediakan awak dan menangani perawatan serta asuransi.

segments.src: You decide where the ship goes and you pay the trip-related costs: fuel, port charges, canal tolls.
segments.tr: Anda memutuskan ke mana kapal pergi dan membayar biaya perjalanan: bahan bakar, biaya pelabuhan, dan biaya kanal.

segments.src: If the ship breaks down and can't work, it usually goes **off-hire**, which means you stop paying hire until it's working again.
segments.tr: Jika kapal rusak dan tidak bisa bekerja, biasanya kapal menjadi **off-hire**, artinya Anda berhenti membayar hire sampai kapal kembali beroperasi.

segments.src: Bareboat (demise) charter: renting just the ship (like a long-term car lease with no driver)**
segments.tr: Bareboat (demise) charter: menyewa kapal saja (seperti sewa mobil jangka panjang tanpa sopir)**

segments.src: You get the bare ship and run it as if you owned it.
segments.tr: Anda menerima kapal kosong dan mengoperasikannya seolah-olah milik sendiri.

segments.src: You hire the crew and pay for maintenance, insurance, and all running costs, often for many years.
segments.tr: Anda mempekerjakan awak dan membayar perawatan, asuransi, dan seluruh biaya operasional, sering kali selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: The owner keeps legal title and collects the rent.
segments.tr: Pemilik tetap memegang hak hukum dan menerima sewa.

segments.src: Bareboat charters are often used as a financing tool, for example when a bank or leasing company owns the ship and the operator pays it off over time.
segments.tr: Bareboat charter sering dipakai sebagai alat pembiayaan, misalnya saat bank atau perusahaan leasing memiliki kapal dan operator melunasinya secara bertahap.

segments.src: To sum up: as you move from voyage to time to bareboat, the charterer gains more control and also takes on more cost and more risk.
segments.tr: Singkatnya: saat beralih dari voyage ke time lalu ke bareboat, penyewa memperoleh kendali lebih besar tetapi juga menanggung biaya dan risiko yang lebih besar.

segments.src: **Laytime, demurrage, and despatch**
segments.tr: **Laytime, demurrage, dan despatch**

segments.tr: Keterlambatan di pelabuhan paling berpengaruh pada voyage charter.

segments.src: The owner is paid by the trip, so every day the ship sits at the dock waiting is a day it isn't earning.
segments.tr: Pemilik dibayar per perjalanan, sehingga setiap hari kapal menunggu di dermaga adalah hari ketika kapal tidak menghasilkan pendapatan.

segments.src: The contract therefore sets **laytime**, the amount of time the charterer is allowed for loading and unloading.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu kontrak menetapkan **laytime**, yaitu jumlah waktu yang diberikan kepada penyewa untuk memuat dan membongkar.

segments.src: - Go over laytime and the charterer pays **demurrage**, a daily rate agreed in advance to compensate the owner.
segments.tr: - Jika melebihi laytime, penyewa membayar **demurrage**, tarif harian yang disepakati di muka sebagai kompensasi bagi pemilik.

segments.src: - Finish early and some contracts pay the charterer **despatch**, a reward that is often set at half the demurrage rate.
segments.tr: - Jika selesai lebih awal, beberapa kontrak membayar **despatch** kepada penyewa sebagai imbalan, yang sering ditetapkan setengah dari tarif demurrage.

ja.title: [国際物流 #6] 船舶のチャーター: 航海傭船・期間傭船・裸傭船（そして追加の一日ごとにお金がかかる理由）

segments.src: > Most cargo ships that carry grain, ore, or oil are rented, not owned. The contract used to rent one is a "charter party," and the type you pick decides who pays for what and who carries the risk of delays.
segments.tr: > 穀物・鉱石・石油を運ぶ貨物船の多くは、所有ではなくチャーター（賃借）されています。その賃貸契約を「チャーターパーティ」と呼び、どの種類を選ぶかによって、費用を誰が負担し、遅延のリスクを誰が負うかが決まります。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日の概念

segments.src: Container lines run fixed schedules, and you buy space on their ships much like buying a seat on a bus.
segments.tr: コンテナ船社は決まったスケジュールで運航しており、バスの座席を買うように、その船のスペースを買います。

segments.src: But if you need to move 60,000 tons of soybeans or a full load of crude oil, you rent a whole ship.
segments.tr: しかし、6万トンの大豆や原油1船分の積荷を運ぶ場合は、船全体を借りることになります。

segments.src: That rental is called **chartering**, and the contract is called a **charter party**.
segments.tr: この賃借は**チャータリング**と呼ばれ、契約書は**チャーターパーティ**と呼ばれます。

segments.src: The ship's owner is the **shipowner**.
segments.tr: 船の所有者は**船主（シップオーナー）**です。

segments.src: The person renting it is the **charterer**.
segments.tr: 借りる側は**傭船者（チャーラー）**です。

segments.src: There are three main types.
segments.tr: 主な種類は3つあります。

segments.src: The easiest way to remember them is how much of the ship you take over:
segments.tr: 覚え方は、船のどこまでを借りるかで整理するのが簡単です:

segments.src: Voyage charter: renting a trip (like a taxi)**
segments.tr: 航海傭船：航海を借りる（タクシーのような形）**

segments.src: You hire the ship to carry a specific cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: 特定の積荷をA港からB港まで運ぶために船を雇います。

segments.src: The shipowner runs the ship and pays its operating and voyage costs: crew, fuel (called *bunkers*), and usually port charges.
segments.tr: 船主が船を運航し、乗組員、燃料（*バンカー*と呼ばれます）、通常は港湾費用など、運航費と航海に関する費用を負担します。

segments.src: You pay **freight**, usually a price per ton of cargo (for example, $45 per ton).
segments.tr: 支払うのは**運賃（フレイト）**で、通常は積荷1トンあたりの単価です（例：1トンあたり45ドル）。

segments.src: Your main job is to get the cargo loaded and unloaded on time.
segments.tr: 主な役割は、期限内に積荷の積み込みと荷降ろしを完了させることです。

segments.src: Time charter: renting the ship for a period (like a car with a driver)**
segments.tr: 期間傭船：一定期間船を借りる（運転手付きの車のような形）**

segments.src: You rent the ship for a set time, such as six months or one round trip, and pay **hire** at a daily rate (for example, $15,000 per day).
segments.tr: 6か月や1往復など、決まった期間船を借り、**傭船料（ハイヤー）**を日額で支払います（例：1日あたり15,000ドル）。

segments.src: The owner still provides the crew and handles maintenance and insurance.
segments.tr: 船主は引き続き乗組員を配置し、整備と保険も担当します。

segments.src: You decide where the ship goes and you pay the trip-related costs: fuel, port charges, canal tolls.
segments.tr: 船の航路は借り主が決め、燃料、港湾費用、運河通航料などの航海関連費用を負担します。

segments.src: If the ship breaks down and can't work, it usually goes **off-hire**, which means you stop paying hire until it's working again.
segments.tr: 船が故障して稼働できなくなった場合、通常は**オフハイヤー**となり、再び稼働するまで傭船料の支払いが止まります。

segments.src: Bareboat (demise) charter: renting just the ship (like a long-term car lease with no driver)**
segments.tr: 裸傭船（デマイズ傭船）：船体だけを借りる（乗務員なしの長期リースのような形）**

segments.src: You get the bare ship and run it as if you owned it.
segments.tr: 借り主は船体だけを受け取り、自分の所有船であるかのように運航します。

segments.src: You hire the crew and pay for maintenance, insurance, and all running costs, often for many years.
segments.tr: 乗組員を雇用し、整備、保険、その他の運航費用をすべて負担します。契約期間は何年にもわたることが多いです。

segments.src: The owner keeps legal title and collects the rent.
segments.tr: 船主は法的な所有権を保持し、賃料を受け取ります。

segments.src: Bareboat charters are often used as a financing tool, for example when a bank or leasing company owns the ship and the operator pays it off over time.
segments.tr: 裸傭船は、銀行やリース会社が船を所有し、運航者が長期にわたって支払っていくような、資金調達の手段として使われることが多いです。

segments.src: To sum up: as you move from voyage to time to bareboat, the charterer gains more control and also takes on more cost and more risk.
segments.tr: まとめると、航海傭船から期間傭船、裸傭船へと進むにつれて、借り主の支配力は増える一方で、費用とリスクも増えていきます。

segments.src: **Laytime, demurrage, and despatch**
segments.tr: **荷役期間、滞船料、早出奨励金**

segments.src: Delays at port matter most in a voyage charter.
segments.tr: 港での遅延は、航海傭船で最も重要になります。

segments.src: The owner is paid by the trip, so every day the ship sits at the dock waiting is a day it isn't earning.
segments.tr: 船主は航海単位で報酬を得るため、船がドックで待機しているすべての日は、稼げない日になります。

segments.src: The contract therefore sets **laytime**, the amount of time the charterer is allowed for loading and unloading.
segments.tr: そのため契約では**荷役期間（ライタイム）**、つまり積み込みと荷降ろしに借り主が使える期間を定めます。

segments.src: - Go over laytime and the charterer pays **demurrage**, a daily rate agreed in advance to compensate the owner.
segments.tr: - 荷役期間を超過した場合、借り主は**滞船料（デマレージ）**を支払います。これは船主への補償として事前に合意された日額です。

segments.src: - Finish early and some contracts pay the charterer **despatch**, a reward that is often set at half the demurrage rate.
segments.tr: - 早く終えた場合、契約によっては借り主に**早出奨励金（ディスパッチ）**が支払われます。これは多くの場合、滞船料の半額に設定されます。

segments.src: The details really matter here.
segments.tr: ここでは細部が本当に重要です。

segments.src: When does the laytime clock start?
segments.tr: 荷役期間の計時はいつ始まるのでしょうか？

segments.src: Usually after the ship arrives and the master gives a *Notice of Readiness*.
segments.tr: 通常は、船が到着し、船長が*荷役準備完了通知（NOR）*を出した後に始まります。

segments.src: Do weekends, holidays, or rain days count?
segments.tr: 週末、祝日、雨天の日は算入されるのでしょうか？

segments.src: Small wording differences can mean tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: わずかな文言の違いで、数万ドルもの差が生じることがあります。

segments.src: Many charter parties follow the principle "once on demurrage, always on demurrage": after laytime runs out, interruptions that would normally stop the clock usually stop counting in the charterer's favor.
segments.tr: 多くの傭船契約は「一度滞船料が発生したら、常に滞船料が発生する（Once on demurrage, always on demurrage）」という原則に従います。荷役期間が尽きた後は、本来なら計時を止めるはずの中断事由があっても、借り主に有利には扱われないことが多いです。

segments.src: (Trucking and container shipping also use the word "demurrage," along with "detention," but there it means fees for keeping containers or equipment too long.
segments.tr: （トラック輸送やコンテナ輸送でも「デマレージ」という言葉が使われ、「ディテンション」と並んで、コンテナや機材を長く保管しすぎた場合の料金を指します。

segments.src: The idea is related but the contracts are different.)
segments.tr: 考え方は関連していますが、契約は異なります。）

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常の例

segments.src: Picture a grain exporter in Louisiana shipping 60,000 metric tons of soybeans from an elevator on the lower Mississippi River to China.
segments.tr: ルイジアナ州の穀物輸出業者が、ミシシッピ川下流のエレベーターから中国へ6万メトリックトンの大豆を輸送するとします。

segments.src: A container service won't work at this scale, so the exporter books a bulk carrier on a **voyage charter**:
segments.tr: この規模ではコンテナサービスは使えないため、輸出業者は**航海傭船**で不定期船（バルカー）を手配します：

segments.src: - Freight: $45 per ton, so 60,000 × $45 = **$2.7 million**
segments.tr: - 運賃：1トンあたり45ドル、つまり60,000 × 45ドル = **270万ドル**

segments.src: - Laytime for loading: **4 days**
segments.tr: - 積み込みの荷役期間：**4日間**

segments.src: - Demurrage: **$20,000 per day**; despatch: **$10,000 per day**
segments.tr: - 滞船料：**1日あたり20,000ドル**、早出奨励金：**1日あたり10,000ドル**

segments.src: Harvest season is busy and the elevator is backed up.
segments.tr: 収穫期で忙しく、エレベーターが混雑しています。

segments.src: Loading takes **6 days** instead of 4.
segments.tr: 積み込みに4日ではなく**6日**かかりました。

segments.src: The exporter owes the owner 2 days × $20,000 = **$40,000 in demurrage** on top of the freight.
segments.tr: 輸出業者は運賃に加えて、船主に対して2日 × 20,000ドル = **滞船料40,000ドル**を支払う必要があります。

segments.src: If loading had taken only 3 days, the exporter could have earned **$10,000 in despatch**.
segments.tr: 積み込みが3日で済んでいれば、輸出業者は**早出奨励金10,000ドル**を受け取れたはずです。

segments.src: Now suppose a large trading company has steady volume every month.
segments.tr: 次に、大手商社が毎月安定した取引量を持っているとします。

segments.src: It might **time charter** the same kind of ship for a year at a daily hire rate.
segments.tr: 同じ種類の船を1年間、1日あたりの傭船料で**期間傭船**することもできます。

segments.src: That way it controls the schedule and can line up cargoes back to back, but it also pays for fuel and takes the risk when freight rates fall.
segments.tr: そうすれば、スケジュールを自ら管理し、積荷を途切れなく組むことができますが、燃料費を負担し、運賃相場が下がった場合のリスクも負うことになります。

segments.src: A shipping company that wants to run the ship with its own crew for ten years, without buying it outright, would look at a **bareboat charter**.
segments.tr: 10年間、船を買い取らずに自社の乗組員で運航したい海運会社であれば、**裸傭船**を検討することになるでしょう。

segments.tr: （数字は例示です。

segments.src: Actual freight and hire rates swing widely with the market.)
segments.tr: 実際の運賃や傭船料は市況によって大きく変動します。）

de.title: [International Logistics #6] Ein Schiff chartern: Reise-, Zeit- und Bareboat-Charter (und warum jeder zusätzliche Tag Geld kostet)

segments.src: > Most cargo ships that carry grain, ore, or oil are rented, not owned. The contract used to rent one is a "charter party," and the type you pick decides who pays for what and who carries the risk of delays.
segments.tr: > Die meisten Frachtschiffe, die Getreide, Erz oder Öl transportieren, werden gechartert statt besessen. Der Vertrag zur Miete eines solchen Schiffs heißt "Charterpartie", und die Art, die Sie wählen, bestimmt, wer für was bezahlt und wer das Verzögerungsrisiko trägt.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: Container lines run fixed schedules, and you buy space on their ships much like buying a seat on a bus.
segments.tr: Linienreedereien fahren nach festen Fahrplänen, und Sie kaufen Platz auf deren Schiffen ungefähr so, wie Sie einen Sitzplatz im Bus kaufen.

segments.src: But if you need to move 60,000 tons of soybeans or a full load of crude oil, you rent a whole ship.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie aber 60.000 Tonnen Sojabohnen oder eine volle Ladung Rohöl bewegen müssen, mieten Sie ein ganzes Schiff.

segments.src: That rental is called **chartering**, and the contract is called a **charter party**.
segments.tr: Diese Miete heißt **Chartern**, und der Vertrag heißt **Charterpartie**.

segments.src: The ship's owner is the **shipowner**.
segments.tr: Der Eigentümer des Schiffs ist der **Reeder**.

segments.src: The person renting it is the **charterer**.
segments.tr: Wer es mietet, ist der **Charterer**.

segments.src: There are three main types.
segments.tr: Es gibt drei Haupttypen.

segments.src: The easiest way to remember them is how much of the ship you take over:
segments.tr: Am einfachsten merkt man sie sich daran, wie viel vom Schiff man übernimmt:

segments.src: Voyage charter: renting a trip (like a taxi)**
segments.tr: Reisecharter: Mieten einer Reise (wie ein Taxi)**

segments.src: You hire the ship to carry a specific cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: Sie chartern das Schiff, um eine bestimmte Ladung von Hafen A nach Hafen B zu befördern.

segments.src: The shipowner runs the ship and pays its operating and voyage costs: crew, fuel (called *bunkers*), and usually port charges.
segments.tr: Der Reeder betreibt das Schiff und trägt die Betriebs- und Reisekosten: Besatzung, Treibstoff (*Bunker*) und in der Regel Hafengebühren.

segments.src: You pay **freight**, usually a price per ton of cargo (for example, $45 per ton).
segments.tr: Sie zahlen **Fracht**, meist einen Preis pro Tonne Ladung (zum Beispiel 45 $ pro Tonne).

segments.src: Your main job is to get the cargo loaded and unloaded on time.
segments.tr: Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist, dass die Ladung rechtzeitig be- und entladen wird.

segments.src: Time charter: renting the ship for a period (like a car with a driver)**
segments.tr: Zeitcharter: Mieten des Schiffs für einen Zeitraum (wie ein Auto mit Fahrer)**

segments.src: You rent the ship for a set time, such as six months or one round trip, and pay **hire** at a daily rate (for example, $15,000 per day).
segments.tr: Sie mieten das Schiff für einen festgelegten Zeitraum, etwa sechs Monate oder eine Rundreise, und zahlen die **Charterrate (Hire)** als Tagessatz (zum Beispiel 15.000 $ pro Tag).

segments.src: The owner still provides the crew and handles maintenance and insurance.
segments.tr: Der Reeder stellt weiterhin die Besatzung und kümmert sich um Wartung und Versicherung.

segments.src: You decide where the ship goes and you pay the trip-related costs: fuel, port charges, canal tolls.
segments.tr: Sie entscheiden, wohin das Schiff fährt, und zahlen die reisebezogenen Kosten: Treibstoff, Hafengebühren, Kanalgebühren.

segments.src: If the ship breaks down and can't work, it usually goes **off-hire**, which means you stop paying hire until it's working again.
segments.tr: Wenn das Schiff ausfällt und nicht arbeiten kann, befindet es sich in der Regel in **Off-Hire**, d. h. Sie zahlen keine Charterrate, bis es wieder einsatzbereit ist.

segments.src: Bareboat (demise) charter: renting just the ship (like a long-term car lease with no driver)**
segments.tr: Bareboat-Charter (Demise-Charter): Mieten nur des Schiffsrumpfs (wie ein langfristiges Autoleasing ohne Fahrer)**

segments.src: You get the bare ship and run it as if you owned it.
segments.tr: Sie erhalten das nackte Schiff und betreiben es, als gehöre es Ihnen.

segments.src: You hire the crew and pay for maintenance, insurance, and all running costs, often for many years.
segments.tr: Sie stellen die Besatzung und zahlen Wartung, Versicherung und alle laufenden Kosten, oft über viele Jahre.

segments.src: The owner keeps legal title and collects the rent.
segments.tr: Der Eigentümer behält den rechtlichen Eigentumstitel und kassiert die Miete.

segments.src: Bareboat charters are often used as a financing tool, for example when a bank or leasing company owns the ship and the operator pays it off over time.
segments.tr: Bareboat-Charter werden häufig als Finanzierungsinstrument genutzt, etwa wenn eine Bank oder Leasinggesellschaft das Schiff besitzt und der Betreiber es im Laufe der Zeit abbezahlt.

segments.src: To sum up: as you move from voyage to time to bareboat, the charterer gains more control and also takes on more cost and more risk.
segments.tr: Zusammengefasst: Je weiter man von der Reise- über die Zeit- zur Bareboat-Charter geht, desto mehr Kontrolle gewinnt der Charterer, übernimmt aber auch mehr Kosten und Risiken.

segments.src: **Laytime, demurrage, and despatch**
segments.tr: **Liegezeit, Liegegeld und Dispatch**

segments.src: Delays at port matter most in a voyage charter.
segments.tr: Verzögerungen im Hafen sind bei der Reisecharter am wichtigsten.

segments.src: The owner is paid by the trip, so every day the ship sits at the dock waiting is a day it isn't earning.
segments.tr: Der Reeder wird pro Reise bezahlt, daher ist jeder Tag, den das Schiff am Kai wartet, ein Tag ohne Einnahmen.

segments.src: The contract therefore sets **laytime**, the amount of time the charterer is allowed for loading and unloading.
segments.tr: Der Vertrag legt deshalb die **Liegezeit (Laytime)** fest, also die Zeit, die dem Charterer für Be- und Entladen zusteht.

segments.src: - Go over laytime and the charterer pays **demurrage**, a daily rate agreed in advance to compensate the owner.
segments.tr: - Überschreitet er die Liegezeit, zahlt der Charterer **Liegegeld (Demurrage)**, einen im Voraus vereinbarten Tagessatz als Entschädigung für den Reeder.

segments.src: - Finish early and some contracts pay the charterer **despatch**, a reward that is often set at half the demurrage rate.
segments.tr: - Ist er früher fertig, zahlen manche Verträge dem Charterer **Dispatch**, eine Prämie, die oft auf die Hälfte des Liegegeldsatzes festgelegt wird.

segments.src: The details really matter here.
segments.tr: Die Details sind hier wirklich wichtig.

segments.src: When does the laytime clock start?
segments.tr: Wann beginnt die Liegezeituhr zu laufen?

segments.src: Usually after the ship arrives and the master gives a *Notice of Readiness*.
segments.tr: In der Regel, nachdem das Schiff angekommen ist und der Kapitän eine *Notice of Readiness* (Bereitschaftsanzeige) abgibt.

segments.src: Do weekends, holidays, or rain days count?
segments.tr: Zählen Wochenenden, Feiertage oder Regentage mit?

segments.src: Small wording differences can mean tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: Kleine Formulierungsunterschiede können zehntausende Dollar bedeuten.

segments.src: Many charter parties follow the principle "once on demurrage, always on demurrage": after laytime runs out, interruptions that would normally stop the clock usually stop counting in the charterer's favor.
segments.tr: Viele Charterparteien folgen dem Grundsatz "Einmal im Liegegeld, immer im Liegegeld": Nachdem die Liegezeit abgelaufen ist, zählen Unterbrechungen, die die Uhr normalerweise anhalten würden, in der Regel zugunsten des Charterers nicht mehr.

segments.src: (Trucking and container shipping also use the word "demurrage," along with "detention," but there it means fees for keeping containers or equipment too long.
segments.tr: (Auch Lkw-Transport und Containerschifffahrt verwenden das Wort "Demurrage" sowie "Detention", meinen dort aber Gebühren für zu lange Standzeiten von Containern oder Ausrüstung.

segments.src: The idea is related but the contracts are different.)
segments.tr: Die Idee ist verwandt, die Verträge sind jedoch verschieden.)

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Picture a grain exporter in Louisiana shipping 60,000 metric tons of soybeans from an elevator on the lower Mississippi River to China.
segments.tr: Stellen Sie sich einen Getreideexporteur in Louisiana vor, der 60.000 metrische Tonnen Sojabohnen aus einem Getreidesilo am unteren Mississippi nach China verschifft.

segments.src: A container service won't work at this scale, so the exporter books a bulk carrier on a **voyage charter**:
segments.tr: Ein Containerdienst kommt in diesem Umfang nicht infrage, daher bucht der Exporteur einen Massengutfrachter als **Reisecharter**:

segments.src: - Freight: $45 per ton, so 60,000 × $45 = **$2.7 million**
segments.tr: - Fracht: 45 $ pro Tonne, also 60.000 × 45 $ = **2,7 Mio. $**

segments.src: - Laytime for loading: **4 days**
segments.tr: - Liegezeit für das Beladen: **4 Tage**

segments.src: - Demurrage: **$20,000 per day**; despatch: **$10,000 per day**
segments.tr: - Liegegeld: **20.000 $ pro Tag**; Dispatch: **10.000 $ pro Tag**

segments.src: Harvest season is busy and the elevator is backed up.
segments.tr: Die Erntesaison ist hektisch, und das Silo ist überlastet.

segments.src: Loading takes **6 days** instead of 4.
segments.tr: Das Beladen dauert **6 Tage** statt 4.

segments.src: The exporter owes the owner 2 days × $20,000 = **$40,000 in demurrage** on top of the freight.
segments.tr: Der Exporteur schuldet dem Reeder 2 Tage × 20.000 $ = **40.000 $ Liegegeld** zusätzlich zur Fracht.

segments.src: If loading had taken only 3 days, the exporter could have earned **$10,000 in despatch**.
segments.tr: Hätte das Beladen nur 3 Tage gedauert, hätte der Exporteur **10.000 $ Dispatch** verdienen können.

segments.src: Now suppose a large trading company has steady volume every month.
segments.tr: Angenommen, ein großes Handelsunternehmen hat jeden Monat gleichbleibendes Volumen.

segments.src: It might **time charter** the same kind of ship for a year at a daily hire rate.
segments.tr: Es könnte dasselbe Schiffstyp für ein Jahr zu einer täglichen Charterrate **zeitchartern**.

segments.src: That way it controls the schedule and can line up cargoes back to back, but it also pays for fuel and takes the risk when freight rates fall.
segments.tr: So kontrolliert es den Fahrplan und kann Ladungen nahtlos aneinanderreihen, übernimmt aber auch die Treibstoffkosten und trägt das Risiko, wenn die Frachtraten fallen.

segments.src: A shipping company that wants to run the ship with its own crew for ten years, without buying it outright, would look at a **bareboat charter**.
segments.tr: Eine Reederei, die das Schiff zehn Jahre lang mit eigener Besatzung betreiben will, ohne es zu kaufen, würde eine **Bareboat-Charter** prüfen.

segments.src: (The numbers are illustrative.
segments.tr: (Die Zahlen dienen der Veranschaulichung.

segments.src: Actual freight and hire rates swing widely with the market.)
segments.tr: Die tatsächlichen Fracht- und Charterraten schwanken je nach Marktlage stark.)

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in 3 Zeilen

segments.src: 1. A **voyage charter** rents one trip (paid per ton), a **time charter** rents a period of time (paid per day), and a **bareboat charter** rents the bare ship for the charterer to run.
segments.tr: 1. Eine **Reisecharter** mietet eine Reise (bezahlt pro Tonne), eine **Zeitcharter** mietet einen Zeitraum (bezahlt pro Tag), und eine **Bareboat-Charter** mietet das nackte Schiff, damit der Charterer es selbst betreibt.

segments.src: 2. Going from voyage to time to bareboat, the charterer takes on more control, more cost, and more risk.
segments.tr: 2. Vom Reise- über den Zeit- bis zum Bareboat-Vertrag übernimmt der Charterer mehr Kontrolle, mehr Kosten und mehr Risiko.

segments.src: 3. **Laytime** is the time allowed for port work. Going over it costs **demurrage**, and finishing early may earn **despatch**.
segments.tr: 3. **Liegezeit** ist die für Hafenarbeiten zugestandene Zeit. Wird sie überschritten, kostet das **Liegegeld**, und wer früher fertig ist, kann **Dispatch** verdienen.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Selbsttest

segments.tr: **Q1.** Wer zahlt bei einer Zeitcharter in der Regel den Treibstoff (Bunker) des Schiffs?

segments.src: A) The shipowner  B) The charterer  C) The port authority
segments.tr: A) Der Reeder  B) Der Charterer  C) Die Hafenbehörde

segments.tr: **Q2.** Richtig/Falsch: Bei einer Bareboat-Charter stellt der Reeder die Besatzung und bezahlt sie.

segments.tr: **Q3.** Die Liegezeit beträgt 3 Tage, das Liegegeld 25.000 $ pro Tag, und das Beladen dauert 5 Tage.

segments.tr: Wie viel Liegegeld ist fällig?

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Begriffe des Tages

segments.src: - **Charter party:** The contract between a shipowner and a charterer for renting a ship.
segments.tr: - **Charterpartie:** Der Vertrag zwischen Reeder und Charterer über die Miete eines Schiffs.

segments.src: - **Voyage charter:** Renting a ship for a specific trip, with freight usually paid per ton of cargo.
segments.tr: - **Reisecharter:** Mieten eines Schiffs für eine bestimmte Reise, wobei die Fracht meist pro Tonne Ladung gezahlt wird.

segments.src: - **Time charter:** Renting a crewed ship for a period at a daily hire rate. The charterer directs where it goes and pays fuel and port costs.
segments.tr: - **Zeitcharter:** Mieten eines bemannten Schiffs für einen Zeitraum gegen eine tägliche Charterrate. Der Charterer bestimmt die Route und zahlt Treibstoff und Hafenkosten.

segments.src: - **Bareboat (demise) charter:** Renting the ship alone. The charterer provides the crew, maintenance, and insurance and operates it like an owner.
segments.tr: - **Bareboat-Charter (Demise-Charter):** Mieten des Schiffs ohne Besatzung. Der Charterer stellt Besatzung, Wartung und Versicherung und betreibt es wie ein Eigentümer.

segments.src: - **Demurrage / Despatch:** The daily payment for going over the agreed laytime, and the reward (often half the demurrage rate) for finishing early.
segments.tr: - **Liegegeld (Demurrage) / Dispatch:** Die tägliche Zahlung für das Überschreiten der vereinbarten Liegezeit und die Prämie (oft die Hälfte des Liegegeldsatzes) für frühzeitige Fertigstellung.

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – B.
segments.tr: *Antworten: Q1 – B.

segments.src: In a time charter the owner provides the crew and keeps the ship running, and the charterer pays trip costs such as fuel and port charges.
segments.tr: Bei einer Zeitcharter stellt der Reeder die Besatzung und hält das Schiff in Betrieb, während der Charterer die Reisekosten wie Treibstoff und Hafengebühren trägt.

segments.tr: Q2 – Falsch.

segments.src: In a bareboat charter the charterer hires and pays the crew; the owner provides only the ship.
segments.tr: Bei einer Bareboat-Charter stellt und bezahlt der Charterer die Besatzung; der Reeder stellt nur das Schiff.

vi.title: [Logistics quốc tế #6] Thuê tàu: thuê chuyến, thuê định hạn và thuê trần (và vì sao mỗi ngày thừa đều tốn tiền)

segments.src: > Most cargo ships that carry grain, ore, or oil are rented, not owned. The contract used to rent one is a "charter party," and the type you pick decides who pays for what and who carries the risk of delays.
segments.tr: > Phần lớn tàu chở ngũ cốc, quặng hay dầu là tàu thuê chứ không phải tàu sở hữu. Hợp đồng dùng để thuê tàu gọi là "charter party", và loại hợp đồng bạn chọn quyết định ai trả cho việc gì và ai chịu rủi ro khi bị chậm trễ.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Khái niệm hôm nay

segments.src: Container lines run fixed schedules, and you buy space on their ships much like buying a seat on a bus.
segments.tr: Các hãng container chạy theo lịch cố định, và bạn mua chỗ trên tàu của họ giống như mua vé xe buýt.

segments.src: But if you need to move 60,000 tons of soybeans or a full load of crude oil, you rent a whole ship.
segments.tr: Nhưng nếu bạn cần vận chuyển 60.000 tấn đậu nành hoặc một chuyến dầu thô đầy tàu, bạn thuê nguyên một con tàu.

segments.src: That rental is called **chartering**, and the contract is called a **charter party**.
segments.tr: Việc thuê đó gọi là **chartering** (thuê tàu), và hợp đồng gọi là **charter party** (hợp đồng thuê tàu).

segments.src: The ship's owner is the **shipowner**.
segments.tr: Chủ tàu được gọi là **shipowner** (chủ tàu).

segments.src: The person renting it is the **charterer**.
segments.tr: Người thuê tàu là **charterer** (người thuê tàu).

segments.src: There are three main types.
segments.tr: Có ba loại chính.

segments.src: The easiest way to remember them is how much of the ship you take over:
segments.tr: Cách dễ nhớ nhất là xem bạn tiếp quản bao nhiêu phần của con tàu:

segments.src: Voyage charter: renting a trip (like a taxi)**
segments.tr: Thuê chuyến (voyage charter): thuê một chuyến đi (giống như taxi)**

segments.src: You hire the ship to carry a specific cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: Bạn thuê tàu để chở một lô hàng cụ thể từ cảng A đến cảng B.

segments.src: The shipowner runs the ship and pays its operating and voyage costs: crew, fuel (called *bunkers*), and usually port charges.
segments.tr: Chủ tàu vận hành tàu và trả chi phí khai thác cùng chi phí chuyến đi: thuyền viên, nhiên liệu (gọi là *bunkers*), và thường là phí cảng.

segments.src: You pay **freight**, usually a price per ton of cargo (for example, $45 per ton).
segments.tr: Bạn trả **cước vận chuyển (freight)**, thường tính theo giá mỗi tấn hàng (ví dụ 45 USD mỗi tấn).

segments.src: Your main job is to get the cargo loaded and unloaded on time.
segments.tr: Nhiệm vụ chính của bạn là bốc và dỡ hàng đúng thời hạn.

segments.src: Time charter: renting the ship for a period (like a car with a driver)**
segments.tr: Thuê định hạn (time charter): thuê tàu trong một khoảng thời gian (giống như thuê xe có tài xế)**

segments.src: You rent the ship for a set time, such as six months or one round trip, and pay **hire** at a daily rate (for example, $15,000 per day).
segments.tr: Bạn thuê tàu trong một khoảng thời gian cố định, chẳng hạn sáu tháng hoặc một chuyến khứ hồi, và trả **cước thuê (hire)** theo giá ngày (ví dụ 15.000 USD mỗi ngày).

segments.src: The owner still provides the crew and handles maintenance and insurance.
segments.tr: Chủ tàu vẫn cung cấp thuyền viên và lo bảo trì cùng bảo hiểm.

segments.src: You decide where the ship goes and you pay the trip-related costs: fuel, port charges, canal tolls.
segments.tr: Bạn quyết định tàu đi đâu và trả các chi phí liên quan đến chuyến đi: nhiên liệu, phí cảng, phí qua kênh đào.

segments.src: If the ship breaks down and can't work, it usually goes **off-hire**, which means you stop paying hire until it's working again.
segments.tr: Nếu tàu hỏng và không thể hoạt động, tàu thường chuyển sang **ngừng tính cước (off-hire)**, nghĩa là bạn ngừng trả cước thuê cho đến khi tàu hoạt động trở lại.

segments.src: Bareboat (demise) charter: renting just the ship (like a long-term car lease with no driver)**
segments.tr: Thuê trần (bareboat/demise charter): chỉ thuê vỏ tàu (giống như thuê xe dài hạn không có tài xế)**

segments.src: You get the bare ship and run it as if you owned it.
segments.tr: Bạn nhận con tàu trơ trụi và vận hành nó như thể bạn là chủ sở hữu.

segments.src: You hire the crew and pay for maintenance, insurance, and all running costs, often for many years.
segments.tr: Bạn thuê thuyền viên và trả chi phí bảo trì, bảo hiểm cùng mọi chi phí vận hành, thường trong nhiều năm.

segments.src: The owner keeps legal title and collects the rent.
segments.tr: Chủ tàu giữ quyền sở hữu hợp pháp và thu tiền thuê.

segments.src: Bareboat charters are often used as a financing tool, for example when a bank or leasing company owns the ship and the operator pays it off over time.
segments.tr: Thuê trần thường được dùng như một công cụ tài chính, ví dụ khi ngân hàng hoặc công ty cho thuê tài chính sở hữu tàu và bên vận hành trả dần theo thời gian.

segments.src: To sum up: as you move from voyage to time to bareboat, the charterer gains more control and also takes on more cost and more risk.
segments.tr: Tóm lại: khi chuyển từ thuê chuyến sang thuê định hạn rồi thuê trần, người thuê có thêm quyền kiểm soát, nhưng cũng phải gánh thêm chi phí và rủi ro.

segments.src: **Laytime, demurrage, and despatch**
segments.tr: **Laytime, demurrage và despatch**

segments.src: Delays at port matter most in a voyage charter.
segments.tr: Sự chậm trễ tại cảng quan trọng nhất trong thuê chuyến.

segments.src: The owner is paid by the trip, so every day the ship sits at the dock waiting is a day it isn't earning.
segments.tr: Chủ tàu được trả theo chuyến, nên mỗi ngày tàu nằm chờ ở bến là một ngày tàu không kiếm được tiền.

segments.src: The contract therefore sets **laytime**, the amount of time the charterer is allowed for loading and unloading.
segments.tr: Vì vậy hợp đồng quy định **laytime** (thời gian bốc dỡ cho phép), tức là khoảng thời gian người thuê được phép dùng để bốc và dỡ hàng.

segments.src: - Go over laytime and the charterer pays **demurrage**, a daily rate agreed in advance to compensate the owner.
segments.tr: - Vượt quá laytime, người thuê phải trả **demurrage** (phí quá hạn bốc dỡ), một mức phí theo ngày được thỏa thuận trước để bồi thường cho chủ tàu.

segments.src: - Finish early and some contracts pay the charterer **despatch**, a reward that is often set at half the demurrage rate.
segments.tr: - Hoàn thành sớm, một số hợp đồng trả cho người thuê **despatch** (thưởng bốc dỡ nhanh), thường được đặt bằng một nửa mức demurrage.

segments.src: The details really matter here.
segments.tr: Chi tiết ở đây thực sự quan trọng.

segments.src: When does the laytime clock start?
segments.tr: Đồng hồ laytime bắt đầu tính khi nào?

segments.src: Usually after the ship arrives and the master gives a *Notice of Readiness*.
segments.tr: Thường là sau khi tàu cập cảng và thuyền trưởng đưa ra *Notice of Readiness* (thông báo sẵn sàng).

segments.src: Do weekends, holidays, or rain days count?
segments.tr: Ngày nghỉ cuối tuần, ngày lễ hay ngày mưa có được tính không?

segments.src: Small wording differences can mean tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: Chỉ một khác biệt nhỏ trong cách diễn đạt cũng có thể lên đến hàng chục nghìn đô la.

segments.src: Many charter parties follow the principle "once on demurrage, always on demurrage": after laytime runs out, interruptions that would normally stop the clock usually stop counting in the charterer's favor.
segments.tr: Nhiều hợp đồng thuê tàu tuân theo nguyên tắc "đã vào demurrage thì luôn ở demurrage": sau khi hết laytime, những gián đoạn thường làm dừng đồng hồ thì thường không còn được tính có lợi cho người thuê nữa.

segments.src: (Trucking and container shipping also use the word "demurrage," along with "detention," but there it means fees for keeping containers or equipment too long.
segments.tr: (Vận tải đường bộ và vận tải container cũng dùng từ "demurrage", cùng với "detention", nhưng ở đó nó có nghĩa là phí giữ container hoặc thiết bị quá lâu.

segments.src: The idea is related but the contracts are different.)
segments.tr: Ý tưởng có liên quan nhưng hợp đồng thì khác nhau.)

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong đời sống hằng ngày

segments.src: Picture a grain exporter in Louisiana shipping 60,000 metric tons of soybeans from an elevator on the lower Mississippi River to China.
segments.tr: Hãy hình dung một nhà xuất khẩu ngũ cốc ở Louisiana vận chuyển 60.000 tấn đậu nành (metric ton) từ một kho chứa trên hạ lưu sông Mississippi sang Trung Quốc.

segments.src: A container service won't work at this scale, so the exporter books a bulk carrier on a **voyage charter**:
segments.tr: Dịch vụ container không phù hợp với quy mô này, nên nhà xuất khẩu đặt một tàu chở hàng rời theo **thuê chuyến**:

segments.src: - Freight: $45 per ton, so 60,000 × $45 = **$2.7 million**
segments.tr: - Cước vận chuyển: 45 USD mỗi tấn, tức 60.000 × 45 USD = **2,7 triệu USD**

segments.src: - Laytime for loading: **4 days**
segments.tr: - Laytime bốc hàng: **4 ngày**

segments.src: - Demurrage: **$20,000 per day**; despatch: **$10,000 per day**
segments.tr: - Demurrage: **20.000 USD mỗi ngày**; despatch: **10.000 USD mỗi ngày**

segments.src: Harvest season is busy and the elevator is backed up.
segments.tr: Mùa thu hoạch bận rộn và kho chứa đang bị tắc.

segments.src: Loading takes **6 days** instead of 4.
segments.tr: Việc bốc hàng mất **6 ngày** thay vì 4.

segments.src: The exporter owes the owner 2 days × $20,000 = **$40,000 in demurrage** on top of the freight.
segments.tr: Nhà xuất khẩu phải trả cho chủ tàu 2 ngày × 20.000 USD = **40.000 USD tiền demurrage** ngoài cước vận chuyển.

segments.src: If loading had taken only 3 days, the exporter could have earned **$10,000 in despatch**.
segments.tr: Nếu việc bốc hàng chỉ mất 3 ngày, nhà xuất khẩu đã có thể nhận **10.000 USD tiền despatch**.

segments.src: Now suppose a large trading company has steady volume every month.
segments.tr: Giả sử một công ty thương mại lớn có khối lượng hàng đều đặn mỗi tháng.

segments.src: It might **time charter** the same kind of ship for a year at a daily hire rate.
segments.tr: Công ty này có thể **thuê định hạn** cùng loại tàu đó trong một năm với mức cước thuê theo ngày.

segments.src: That way it controls the schedule and can line up cargoes back to back, but it also pays for fuel and takes the risk when freight rates fall.
segments.tr: Như vậy công ty kiểm soát được lịch trình và có thể xếp các lô hàng nối tiếp nhau, nhưng cũng phải trả tiền nhiên liệu và chịu rủi ro khi giá cước vận chuyển giảm.

segments.src: A shipping company that wants to run the ship with its own crew for ten years, without buying it outright, would look at a **bareboat charter**.
segments.tr: Một công ty vận tải muốn tự vận hành tàu bằng thuyền viên của mình trong mười năm, mà không mua đứt con tàu, sẽ cân nhắc **thuê trần**.

segments.src: (The numbers are illustrative.
segments.tr: (Các con số chỉ mang tính minh họa.

segments.src: Actual freight and hire rates swing widely with the market.)
segments.tr: Giá cước vận chuyển và cước thuê thực tế biến động mạnh theo thị trường.)

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt 3 dòng

segments.src: 1. A **voyage charter** rents one trip (paid per ton), a **time charter** rents a period of time (paid per day), and a **bareboat charter** rents the bare ship for the charterer to run.
segments.tr: 1. **Thuê chuyến** là thuê một chuyến đi (trả theo tấn), **thuê định hạn** là thuê trong một khoảng thời gian (trả theo ngày), còn **thuê trần** là thuê vỏ tàu để người thuê tự vận hành.

segments.src: 2. Going from voyage to time to bareboat, the charterer takes on more control, more cost, and more risk.
segments.tr: 2. Đi từ thuê chuyến sang thuê định hạn rồi thuê trần, người thuê có thêm quyền kiểm soát, thêm chi phí và thêm rủi ro.

segments.src: 3. **Laytime** is the time allowed for port work. Going over it costs **demurrage**, and finishing early may earn **despatch**.
segments.tr: 3. **Laytime** là thời gian cho phép làm việc tại cảng. Vượt quá sẽ phải trả **demurrage**, còn hoàn thành sớm có thể được **despatch**.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Charter party:** The contract between a shipowner and a charterer for renting a ship.
segments.tr: - **Charter party:** Hợp đồng giữa chủ tàu và người thuê tàu để thuê một con tàu.

segments.src: - **Voyage charter:** Renting a ship for a specific trip, with freight usually paid per ton of cargo.
segments.tr: - **Thuê chuyến (voyage charter):** Thuê tàu cho một chuyến đi cụ thể, cước vận chuyển thường tính theo tấn hàng.

segments.src: - **Time charter:** Renting a crewed ship for a period at a daily hire rate. The charterer directs where it goes and pays fuel and port costs.
segments.tr: - **Thuê định hạn (time charter):** Thuê tàu có thuyền viên trong một khoảng thời gian với cước thuê theo ngày. Người thuê quyết định tàu đi đâu và trả nhiên liệu cùng chi phí cảng.

segments.src: - **Bareboat (demise) charter:** Renting the ship alone. The charterer provides the crew, maintenance, and insurance and operates it like an owner.
segments.tr: - **Thuê trần (bareboat/demise charter):** Thuê riêng vỏ tàu. Người thuê cung cấp thuyền viên, bảo trì và bảo hiểm, đồng thời vận hành tàu như chủ sở hữu.

segments.src: - **Demurrage / Despatch:** The daily payment for going over the agreed laytime, and the reward (often half the demurrage rate) for finishing early.
segments.tr: - **Demurrage / Despatch:** Khoản trả theo ngày khi vượt quá laytime đã thỏa thuận, và khoản thưởng (thường bằng một nửa mức demurrage) khi hoàn thành sớm.

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – B.
segments.tr: *Đáp án: Q1 – B.

segments.src: In a time charter the owner provides the crew and keeps the ship running, and the charterer pays trip costs such as fuel and port charges.
segments.tr: Trong thuê định hạn, chủ tàu cung cấp thuyền viên và giữ tàu hoạt động, còn người thuê trả các chi phí chuyến đi như nhiên liệu và phí cảng.
